Maya: Quick mid‑quarter check — need a compact status for auth subsystem and handoff items for exec slide. What shipped, what slipped, owners?

Sanjay: Shipped: basic token refresh, session KV caching, and UI refresh for reauth. PRs merged: #4321, #4325. Latency improved overall but saw an edge tail increase.

Olivia: Nice. Was delegated auth rollout on track?

Juan: Delegated rollout blocked by a prod firewall rule change — INF-987. I'm the owner, ETA tomorrow EOD to get approvals.

Li: Heads up — after the token cache change we saw p99 tail latency jump from ~380ms -> ~520ms on auth paths. Investigating.

Sanjay: Confirmed the batching tweak caused the tail blip. Short term: I'm pushing a hotfix to disable continuous batching on auth routes. Will follow up with a perf check.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: hotfix-auth-batching rolled to prod at 1719236000 :white_check_mark:

Maya: Ok good. Can we have a short shipped/slipped matrix I can paste into the deck? Also list next steps and owners.

Sanjay: ```
Shipped:
 - token-refresh (owner: Sanjay) — PR #4321
 - session-kv-cache (owner: Sanjay) — PR #4325

Slipped / Blocked:
 - delegated-auth rollout (owner: Juan) — blocked by INF-987 (firewall)
 - continuous-batching perf fix (owner: Sanjay) — hotfix rolled, full perf validation in progress

Next steps:
 - Sanjay: finish perf validation + postmortem note
 - Juan: clear firewall approvals (ETA: tomorrow EOD)
 - Mike: update telemetry schema for auth events (PR 4555)
```

Olivia: Quick CR ping: Sanjay can you get a reviewer on #4333 (config refactor)? Need infra eyes @Juan and SRE eyes @Li.

Li: I'll review #4333 tonight, can focus on the batching/config bits.

Juan: I'll take infra review tomorrow morning and unblock firewall ticket if approvals arrive. Payments stack not affected. One dependent: telemetry event change — Mike, you on that?

Mike: Yup, I'll finish schema update and land PR 4555 by tomorrow AM.

Maya: Perfect. Summary for exec slide: shipped items (token refresh + KV cache), one perf regression mitigated by hotfix (in validation), delegated-auth rollout slipped — firewall approval pending (Juan), telemetry schema pending (Mike). Owners assigned and CRs in flight. I'll update slides and ping this thread if exec asks for details. :thumbsup:

Sanjay: Adding a short note — if perf validation looks clean, we can re-enable optimized batching with a canary next week.

Maya: Great — thanks everyone, will circulate slide and backlog actions. If anything slips further, post here and I'll escalate.
